# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[Internal medicine graphical thumbnail portrait image 2]

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal. 

[Vaccines][115]

lives of cancer patients worldwide.

[Oncology][120]

operational and R&D excellence.”

the highlights in our Annual Report.

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,

people can live healthier, longer lives.

# Your influence. Tracked. Explained. Visualized.

Altmetric’s interface tracks online engagement to reveal how and where your research is making a
difference.

[Request a demo][114]

## Reveal online attention to research at speed

Thousands of conversations about research happen online every day. Altmetric tracks and captures a
range of online attention sources to published research across social media, news outlets, policy
and more. We collate this activity, to help you monitor, report and showcase the attention
surrounding the research you care about.

Academic Resource Center — Established 2004

## The Scientific Study of Antibiotics:
## Pharmacology & Antimicrobial Stewardship

This Institute provides peer-reviewed, evidence-based academic monographs on the pharmacology,
mechanisms of action, and clinical microbiology of systemic antibiotics. All content is produced for
educational and research purposes and does not constitute medical advice.

[Browse Monographs][6] [Read: OTC Antibiotic Risks][7]

## Our Academic Mission

The Institute for Antimicrobial Research and Pharmacology (IARP) operates under the academic mandate
to advance the rigorous, unbiased scientific understanding of antimicrobial agents. Our Department
of Clinical Microbiology & Pharmacology produces in-depth monographs on antibiotic classes currently
approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA), examining each agent through the
lens of modern pharmacodynamics and molecular microbiology.

In an era of accelerating antimicrobial resistance (AMR), the Institute's mission extends beyond
pharmacokinetic description. We critically analyze the public health implications of antibiotic use
patterns, resistance emergence mechanisms, and the imperative of evidence-based antimicrobial
stewardship programs (ASPs) in both hospital and community settings across the United States.

### Research Focus Areas
* ▸ Antibiotic Mechanisms of Action
* ▸ Pharmacokinetics & Pharmacodynamics
* ▸ Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)
* ▸ Antimicrobial Stewardship Programs
* ▸ Microbiome & Dysbiosis Research
* ▸ FDA Regulatory Pharmacology

of action, pharmacokinetics, spectrum of activity, and resistance considerations.

Featured Scholarly Article

### OTC Antibiotics & AMR

A peer-reviewed analysis of FDA regulations distinguishing topical OTC antibiotics from systemic
prescription agents, and the public health consequences of unregulated systemic antibiotic access.

[ Read Article → ][13]

## The Global AMR Crisis: An Urgent Academic Priority

The World Health Organization (WHO) and the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
(CDC) classify antimicrobial resistance (AMR) as one of the gravest threats to global public health.
In the United States alone, the CDC estimates that more than 2.8 million antibiotic-resistant
infections occur annually, resulting in over 35,000 deaths. The Institute's research is directly
aligned with understanding and communicating the pharmacological and epidemiological underpinnings
of this crisis.

## Departmental Research Pillars

### Pharmacological Analysis

Rigorous examination of pharmacokinetics (PK), pharmacodynamics (PD), and the molecular mechanisms
by which antibiotic agents achieve bacteriostatic or bactericidal effects.

### Resistance Mechanisms

Comprehensive study of intrinsic and acquired AMR mechanisms including enzymatic inactivation
(beta-lactamases), efflux pump upregulation, target modification, and horizontal gene transfer.

### Public Health & Stewardship

Analysis of antimicrobial stewardship programs (ASPs), FDA regulatory frameworks, and the
epidemiology of antibiotic misuse in the United States healthcare system.

# Home Biose

# Your microbiome partner
# for health and well-being
# Microbiome. Manufacturing. Mastered.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial
supply.

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

Welcome to Cencora

# Find solutions that pave a reliable path to patients

Explore our full range of solutions designed to help you bring innovations to market and improve
care delivery worldwide.
[ Explore our solutions ][90]
[A light-skinned person wearing a white track jacket and a bright t-shirt jogging through a park
with the morning sun shining behind their head.]

## Distribution, commercialization, patient access, and pharmacy solutions for manufacturers,
## providers, and health systems.

We combine global capabilities and local expertise to help healthcare professionals bring
life-saving therapies, preventive treatments, and high-quality care to communities around the world.

[Logistics and warehousing][91] **

Leverage our global network to ensure safe, secure storage and timely delivery worldwide.

[ Drug research and clinical development support ][92] **

Streamline the drug development process and minimize go-to-market risk.

[ Commercialization support ][93] **

Build a foundation for a successful product launch and accelerate your speed-to-market.

[ Patient access and adherence support ][94] **

Address barriers to patient access and increase your product's speed-to-therapy.

[ Wholesale and specialty distribution ][95] **

Increase access to medications with our innovative solutions and secure supply chain.

[ Provider solutions ][96] **

Elevate the patient experience and expand care possibilities with physician practice solutions.

[ Pharmacy solutions ][97] **

Build and scale your pharmacy, accelerate growth, and deliver stronger clinical results.

[ Hospital and health system solutions ][98] **

Solve critical problems, plan for sustainable growth, and create better health outcomes.

[ Explore our capabilities ][99]

## Why Cencora

The end-to-end support we provide across the entire healthcare spectrum isn’t the only thing that
sets Cencora apart. There are so many other ways we provide a differentiated experience when you tap
into our unique capabilities.

### Global reach with local expertise

With a presence in over 50 countries, we’re expanding access to care worldwide, while our
community-level insight helps us to deploy resources effectively and efficiently.
[ Learn more about our global reach ][100]

### A commitment to innovation

Together with our industry partners, we’re continuously innovating to meet the needs of our
customers, evolving our solutions, and reshaping how healthcare is delivered.
[ Learn more about our innovation commitment ][101]

### A partner-centric  approach

We work closely with pharma companies and care providers every day, listening to their challenges
and using their insights to develop solutions that will have a positive impact on their patients.
[ Learn more about us ][102]

## What is Cencora?

It’s not easy to fully understand everything Cencora does. With countless solutions and services for
manufacturers, health systems, government entities, physician practices, pharmacies, and more, it’s
practically impossible for us to summarize what we offer without sacrificing some very important
details.

Watch this video to see some of our team members trying to define Cencora, and then check out our
stories to gain deeper insight into our business, our purpose, and our impact.
[ Explore all of our stories ][103]

Explore our full range of solutions designed to help you bring innovations to market and improve

## Distribution, commercialization, patient access, and pharmacy solutions for manufacturers,
## providers, and health systems.

We combine global capabilities and local expertise to help healthcare professionals bring
life-saving therapies, preventive treatments, and high-quality care to communities around the world.

[Logistics and warehousing][91] **

Leverage our global network to ensure safe, secure storage and timely delivery worldwide.

[ Drug research and clinical development support ][92] **

Streamline the drug development process and minimize go-to-market risk.

[ Commercialization support ][93] **

Build a foundation for a successful product launch and accelerate your speed-to-market.

[ Patient access and adherence support ][94] **

Address barriers to patient access and increase your product's speed-to-therapy.

[ Wholesale and specialty distribution ][95] **

Increase access to medications with our innovative solutions and secure supply chain.

[ Provider solutions ][96] **

Elevate the patient experience and expand care possibilities with physician practice solutions.

[ Pharmacy solutions ][97] **

Build and scale your pharmacy, accelerate growth, and deliver stronger clinical results.

[ Hospital and health system solutions ][98] **

Solve critical problems, plan for sustainable growth, and create better health outcomes.

[ Explore our capabilities ][99]

## Why Cencora

The end-to-end support we provide across the entire healthcare spectrum isn’t the only thing that
sets Cencora apart. There are so many other ways we provide a differentiated experience when you tap
into our unique capabilities.

### Global reach with local expertise

With a presence in over 50 countries, we’re expanding access to care worldwide, while our
community-level insight helps us to deploy resources effectively and efficiently.
[ Learn more about our global reach ][100]

### A commitment to innovation

Together with our industry partners, we’re continuously innovating to meet the needs of our
customers, evolving our solutions, and reshaping how healthcare is delivered.
[ Learn more about our innovation commitment ][101]

### A partner-centric  approach

We work closely with pharma companies and care providers every day, listening to their challenges
and using their insights to develop solutions that will have a positive impact on their patients.
[ Learn more about us ][102]

## What is Cencora?

It’s not easy to fully understand everything Cencora does. With countless solutions and services for
manufacturers, health systems, government entities, physician practices, pharmacies, and more, it’s
practically impossible for us to summarize what we offer without sacrificing some very important
details.

* [D-mannose in Cystonette for cystitis]
  
  #### D-mannose
  
  The strongest antibiotic that kills E. coli and coliform bacteria, while preserving the beneficial
  microflora in the body. D-mannose enters the bloodstream, with which it enters the kidneys,
  bladder and excretory canal, producing a complete and effective disinfection. At the same time,
  pathogenic bacteria are washed out, the body's immune system stabilizes and reduces the number of
  signals to urinate.
* [zinc in Cystonette for cystitis]
  
  #### Zinc
  
  It affects the processes of metabolism of nucleic acids, is part of the hormones and enzymes
  necessary for the normal functioning of the body, has anti-inflammatory and antioxidant
  properties, participates in the formation of cellular elements of the blood, is present in large
  quantities in the prostate gland in men, ensuring its normal functioning - a guarantee of the
  absence of cystitis.
* [cranberry in Cystonette]
  
  #### Cranberry

  amount of organic acids, including malic, citric, quinic, oxalic, as well as a complex of
  polysaccharides, in particular pectin, tripeptides. Benzoic acid has a pronounced antifungal and
  antibacterial effect.

  Allergic reactions are possible to the ingredient, it is not recommended for use in gastritis,
  duodenitis, increased acidity in gastric juice, with a duodenal ulcer or stomach ulcer. It has a
  general tonic effect.
* [Buchu leaves in Cystonette]

  wide spectrum of action in the treatment of diseases of the excretory system, including: kidneys,
  bladder, urethra. The ingredient helps with prostatitis, benign prostatic hyperplasia, colds and
  fever, which makes it a good component of the medicine in the treatment of all forms of cystitis.

The drug has a positive effect in 100% of cases of cystitis of one type or another, in two weeks of
taking the pain caused by chronic forms of the disease stops, after 2 days there is relief of all
symptoms, including pain and frequent urination, due to the rapid removal of E. coli from the body,
whichalong with Proteus, streptococcus, viruses, certain types of fungi, mycoplasmas is the cause of
cystitis. Cystonette is a botanical formulation that has been verified through trials, consisting in
part of very rare ingredients that cannot be self-harvested in most countries. Raw materials are
grown and mined in environmentally friendly conditions. Capsules have a pleasant neutral taste,
which does not create discomfort when taking them.

[Doctor Urologist Michael Joist] **Doctor Michael Joist**

Frequent urination caused by cystitis occurs in Germany on average in 30% of women. Everyone suffers
from this disease at least once in their life, the chronic form can disturb for many years, give
complications to the cardiovascular system. Used instead of antibiotics (or for some forms of
cystitis together with them), Cystonette capsules with a natural composition give an effect after
the first application: pain is reduced, incomplete emptying of the bladder is eliminated.
[Cystonette for cystitis]

Cystitis is an infectious inflammation in the wall of the bladder, which occurs periodically in
every second woman and every tenth man. The difference in statistics is due to differences in the
physiology of the sexes: women have a shorter urethra. The disease is considered severe, often
becomes chronic, causes kidney disease, brings severe psychological discomfort due to the need to
frequently visit the toilet, and causes problems in intimate life.

Cystonette capsules for cystitis are a modern innovative development, have passed clinical trials,
and are recommended for use by leading European urologists. Cystonette has a natural composition,
its ingredients are grown and harvested in ecologically clean areas, which guarantees the high
quality of the drug and a quick lasting effect in the treatment and prevention of cystitis. The
total number of female users who have tested positive for cystitis treatment and prevention with
Cystonette exceeds 2 million worldwide.

* [D-mannose in Cystonette for cystitis]
  
  #### D-mannose
  
  The strongest antibiotic that kills E. coli and coliform bacteria, while preserving the beneficial
  microflora in the body. D-mannose enters the bloodstream, with which it enters the kidneys,
  bladder and excretory canal, producing a complete and effective disinfection. At the same time,
  pathogenic bacteria are washed out, the body's immune system stabilizes and reduces the number of
  signals to urinate.
* [zinc in Cystonette for cystitis]
  
  #### Zinc
  
  It affects the processes of metabolism of nucleic acids, is part of the hormones and enzymes
  necessary for the normal functioning of the body, has anti-inflammatory and antioxidant
  properties, participates in the formation of cellular elements of the blood, is present in large
  quantities in the prostate gland in men, ensuring its normal functioning - a guarantee of the
  absence of cystitis.
* [cranberry in Cystonette]
  
  #### Cranberry
  
  A well-known natural antibiotic with a high antimicrobial effect, which is provided by a large
  amount of organic acids, including malic, citric, quinic, oxalic, as well as a complex of
  polysaccharides, in particular pectin, tripeptides. Benzoic acid has a pronounced antifungal and
  antibacterial effect.
* [hibiscus flowers in Cystonette]
  
  #### hibiscus flowers
  
  The Cystonette component is a very active biological substance, it has anthocyanins,
  polysaccharides, hibiscus and malic acids in its chemical composition, it has a delicate diuretic
  effect on the body, cleansing the bladder from harmful bacteria, improving its functioning.
  Allergic reactions are possible to the ingredient, it is not recommended for use in gastritis,
  duodenitis, increased acidity in gastric juice, with a duodenal ulcer or stomach ulcer. It has a
  general tonic effect.

  #### Buchu leaves (agathosma)
  
  A rare plant originating from the mountains of South Africa, as part of Cystonette capsules, has a
  wide spectrum of action in the treatment of diseases of the excretory system, including: kidneys,
  bladder, urethra. The ingredient helps with prostatitis, benign prostatic hyperplasia, colds and
  fever, which makes it a good component of the medicine in the treatment of all forms of cystitis.

taking the pain caused by chronic forms of the disease stops, after 2 days there is relief of all

part of very rare ingredients that cannot be self-harvested in most countries. Raw materials are

# See what your competitors

partners, or emerging disruptors.

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.

  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

foundation-level geospatial data within the open public domain that can be useful to support
community preparedness, resiliency, research, and more.

Answers to everyday science and health questions

### Based On Science
* ### Are there proven treatments for Ebola?
  
  Yes. Scientists have developed treatments that improve survival for Ebola virus disease caused by
  Zaire ebolavirus, especially when patients receive care early. But treatments that work for one
  species of Ebola virus may not work against all Ebola viruses.
  
  [Read Article][57]
* ### Are contrails harmful to the environment?
  
  Some contrails can contribute to global warming. Contrails—pure ice clouds (“cirrus”) that form
  from aircraft exhaust under specific cold conditions—can trap heat in the atmosphere, sometimes
  creating as much warming as the carbon dioxide released by burning jet fuel.
  
  Read Article
* ### Can vitamin A help prevent measles?
  
  Vitamin A does not prevent measles. The most effective way to prevent measles is through
  vaccination. Vitamin A supplements are a tool in reducing complications from measles, but they
  will not prevent infection. Vitamin A, when used under the guidance of a health care provider, may
  reduce the severity of measles, particularly among children at high risk of deficiency. However,
  too much vitamin A is dangerous.
  
  [Read Article][58]

[Our mission][69]
[July 2026]

## America's Pharmacist
* Team building
* Visits that make a difference
* The independent pharmacy ecosystem

[Learn More][70]
[Today With NCPA]

## Today With NCPA

Check out our upcoming NCPA meetings and events.

[Full Calendar][71]
[Neighbors, Not Numbers]

## Neighbors, Not Numbers

When was the last time your chain-store pharmacist asked how you’re doing? Maybe you’re getting your
prescriptions from a mail-order pharmacy. How’s that relationship going? Do they know your name, or
do they treat you like a number? There’s a better experience waiting for you right around the corner
at a family-owned independent community pharmacy.

[Learn More][72]
[NCPA State Panel of Experts]

## NCPA State Panel of Experts

NCPA has assembled a diverse array of experts in different areas to assist states, based on certain
criteria, in their legislative and regulatory initiatives.

[Learn More][73]
[Long-Term Care Pharmacy]

## NCPA's LTC Division

The NCPA Long-Term Care Division is a resource and advocate for independent pharmacies in the LTC
space.

[Learn More][74]

## Member Spotlight

### I am NCPA

### Anna Dimak, PharmD

[Learn more][75]

## Value of NCPA:

NCPA’s value is both networking and advocacy. “The network across the country I’ve already made
through just a few conferences has been so worth the membership,” she says. “I have also valued
being able to advocate at a federal level at (the NCPA Congressional Pharmacy Fly-In) for the last
three years.”

For her, speaking up is part of the job. “Staying up to date with these issues and speaking up is a
priority in my day-to-day professional life,” she says.

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

### From Supply Chain Research

[[2026-07-17-sce-involution-600x370]][23]

##### [Supply Chain Edge: Evolving involution, forecasting transport prices, sourcing Ukraine’s
##### electronics][24]

July 17, 2026

– Mainland China’s anti-involution campaign is set to remain a supply chain policy priority even as
producer prices return to inflation, with the focus shifting from broad capacity cuts to demand
repair, investment discipline and higher returns on capital. The US removal of de minimis...

[More research articles ][25]

## Robust global coverage. Powerful machine learning technologies. Dynamic data visualizations.
## Surge ahead of the competition with Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence.

# Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence Data-driven insights for the global trade community

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

[[Screenshot-network-view-diagram]][22]

### From Supply Chain Research

[[2026-07-17-sce-involution-600x370]][23]

##### [Supply Chain Edge: Evolving involution, forecasting transport prices, sourcing Ukraine’s
##### electronics][24]

July 17, 2026

– Mainland China’s anti-involution campaign is set to remain a supply chain policy priority even as
producer prices return to inflation, with the focus shifting from broad capacity cuts to demand
repair, investment discipline and higher returns on capital. The US removal of de minimis...

[More research articles ][25]

## Robust global coverage. Powerful machine learning technologies. Dynamic data visualizations.
## Surge ahead of the competition with Panjiva Supply Chain Intelligence.

#### FAO and the SDGs

FAO supports governments and partners to design the right policies and programmes to end hunger,
promote food security and promote sustainable agriculture for millions of people around the world.

##### Hover the mouse over an SDG icon for more information

A world free from hunger and malnutrition where food and agriculture contributes to improving the
living standards of all

[sdg photo]

FAO works with governments and partners to empower some of the world’s most marginalized people to
end rural poverty.

[sdg photo]

FAO helps ensure food security by developing ways of growing food that will work in the future so
that millions of people don’t go hungry.

[sdg photo]

Good health starts with nutrition. FAO sets global standards and works with governments and the
private sector to ensure food quality and safety throughout the food chain.

[sdg photo]

FAO invests in educational systems for rural communities and supports improved access to primary
education and school meals in order to create equal opportunities for all and chances of lifelong
learning.

###### 21/07/2026

In a world marked by conflict, climate shocks and economic uncertainty, it is easy to believe hunger
can only get worse. But in 2025, world hunger fell for the third consecutive year. An estimated 645
million people faced hunger, 14 million fewer than in 2024 and 43 million fewer than in 2022,
according to the latest edition of The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World report.

# OUR MISSION IS OF
# GREAT IMPORTANCE.
# JOIN US.

Our mission is to facilitate the discovery and the development of therapies to fight antimicrobial
resistant organisms globally. The Foundation will foster collaborative efforts among industry,
government and academia and will further patient advocacy.

We are motivated by the victims of antimicrobial drug resistance, and we are dedicated to ensuring
that new drugs are affordable, adopted and accessible to everyone who needs them. FCAR is a
non-profit product development partnership to facilitate global research, development for and access
to new antimicrobial agents. [LEARN MORE][10]

##### STRATEGY

+ Facilitate the discovery and development of new treatments.

+ Collaborate among public, private, academic and philanthropic sectors.

+ Establish programs to advance drug therapies as efficiently and rapidly as possible.

+ Ensure therapies are affordable, adopted, and accessible.

##### SCIENTIFIC VISION

Antimicrobial resistance is a serious and challenging global unmet medical need. FCAR will leverage
collaborations around the world to create global solutions to this pandemic.
[READ MORE][11]

##### PARTNERSHIP

FCAR is a non-profit organization that operates on a product development partnership (PDP) model.
The Foundation builds partnerships between public, private, academic and philanthropic sectors.
[READ MORE][12]

Our mission is to facilitate the discovery and the development of therapies to fight antimicrobial
resistant organisms globally. The Foundation will foster collaborative efforts among industry,
government and academia and will further patient advocacy.

We are motivated by the victims of antimicrobial drug resistance, and we are dedicated to ensuring
that new drugs are affordable, adopted and accessible to everyone who needs them. FCAR is a
non-profit product development partnership to facilitate global research, development for and access
to new antimicrobial agents. [LEARN MORE][10]

+ Collaborate among public, private, academic and philanthropic sectors.

+ Establish programs to advance drug therapies as efficiently and rapidly as possible.

siswa khususnya pada bidang sains di Indonesia. OSA diselenggarakansecara **onsite (offline)**

# [ About Us
# ][58]

Hebei Veyong pharmaceutical Co., Ltd, was established in 2002, located in Shijiazhuang City, Hebei
Province, China, next to the Capital Beijing. She is a large GMP-certified veterinary drug
enterprise, with R&D, production and sales of veterinary APIs, preparations, premixed feeds and feed
additives. As Provincial Technical Center, Veyong has established an innovated R&D system for new
veterinary drug, and is the nationally known technological innovation-based veterinary enterprise,
there are 65 technical professionals. Veyong has two production bases: Shijiazhuang and Ordos, of
which the Shijiazhuang base covers an area of 78,706 m2, with 13 API products including Ivermectin,
Eprinomectin, Tiamulin Fumarate, Oxytetracycline hydrochloride ects, and 11 preparation production
lines including injection, oral solution, powder, premix, bolus, pesticides and disinfectant, ects.
Veyong Pharma provides APIs, more than 100 own-label preparations, and OEM & ODM service.
Veyong Pharma attaches great importance to the management of EHS(Environment, Health& Safety)
system, and obtained the ISO14001 and OHSAS18001 certificates. Veyong Pharma has achieved the AEO
certificate, and been listed in the strategic emerging industrial enterprises in Hebei Province and
can ensure the continuous supply of products.
